rows.evidence: Lint HL022 silent; widgets are all preset E.
Profile tables fixed at 800 px.
Full-color preset; palette taken from the era spec.
Verdana and Comic Sans MS stacks; no web fonts.
Default profile tables restyled by a pasted user CSS block, skeleton still visible.
Glitter, blinkies, avatars, and monogram are small GIFs.
All 13 required E widgets marked.
No webring, hit counter, or shared borders.
Brand voice written as a 2007 profile: lowercase, decorated punctuation, no lyrics.
Network text nav bar plus in-profile links.
Glitter name and violet layout make the brand obvious.
Most of the IA mapped; the demo video and login have no slot on this profile.
User CSS inside About Me with profile-style class names; no modern framework.
Online Now, Last Login, profile views, friend and comment counts.
Profiles carried no browser badges, so their absence is era-correct.
Five moving items against a budget of six; gif audit within budget.
Original profile song plays only after a click on PLAY.
Safe Mode verified: sparkle tile dropped, glitter and blinkies frozen.
Alt text throughout, text-only profile linked from the nav bar and footer.
Asset log covers every file; FriendGrid and The Reconcilers are fictional.

notes: Scored by hand in the worked example, then checked with tools/rubric.py against qa/lint-E.json.
